description: Illustrative evidence-gated authoring suggestions; not CLP Annex IV selection logic and not a compliant SDS generator.

rules.rationale: Flag a possible inhalation first-aid phrase where the exposure route and response have been verified. Additional urgent measures may be necessary.
rules.reference: Internal pilot authoring rule; requires toxicological review

rules.expected_english: Rinse immediately carefully and thoroughly with eye-bath or water.
rules.rationale: Candidate eye-exposure wording. Do not treat this as the complete first-aid instruction.
rules.reference: Internal pilot authoring rule; requires medical and regulatory review

rules.expected_english: After contact with skin, wash immediately with plenty of water and soap.
rules.rationale: Candidate skin-irritation advice only when soap and water have been confirmed suitable for this formulation.
rules.reference: Internal pilot authoring rule; requires medical and regulatory review

rules.expected_english: Do not allow to enter into surface water or drains.
rules.rationale: Select only after verifying environmental release controls and applicable waste-water obligations.
rules.reference: Internal pilot authoring rule; site-specific environmental review required

rules.rationale: Storage instruction must be compatible with packaging, venting and pressure hazards.
rules.reference: Internal pilot authoring rule; packaging compatibility review required

rules.expected_english: The quality of the protective gloves resistant to chemicals must be chosen as a function of the specific working place concentration and quantity of hazardous substances.
rules.rationale: General guidance only; glove material, thickness, breakthrough time and relevant standards must be determined separately.
rules.reference: Internal pilot authoring rule; PPE selection and local jurisdiction review required

rules.expected_english: Keep away from heat, hot surfaces, sparks, open flames and other ignition sources. No smoking.
rules.rationale: A Section 10 phrasing option for verified ignition hazards. P-statement selection for Section 2 remains a separate regulatory task.
rules.reference: Internal pilot authoring rule; CLP P-statement selection not implemented
